svg.text: real work vs C (= 1.00×, lower is better), differential I(n₂)−I(n₁) · qemu+insn · x86_64 · sorted by geomean across 18 compute axes († shown, not ranked)
† shown but excluded from the geomean: instruction counts are syscall-blind, misleading for context-switch primitives (see the concurrency study)
‡ JVM ratios are ISA- and run-specific (geomeans up to 1.1× higher on x86_64 than on arm64, single cells up to 2×, see docs/metric-validity.md); non-JVM rankings are ISA-robust
